subject: Clarify publicity & confidentiality carveouts — NovaGrid MSA redlines
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@novagrid.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novagrid.com
Date: 2028-12-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: NovaGrid redlines for MSA + order form — publicity/confidentiality items

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the draft. Attached are NovaGrid's redlines to the MSA and Order Form (see 'NovaGrid_MSA_Redlines_20281201.pdf'). Our procurement and legal teams flagged two areas blocking signature:

- Publicity: they want an explicit opt-out right for any press mentions and separate approval for logo usage.
- Confidentiality: tighter carveouts around aggregate usage metrics and any benchmark data shared with vendors.

We circled specific language in the doc, but the high-level asks are: no automatic case study opt-ins and an embargo window of 6 months for any quoting.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the logo-usage approval workflow and whether you can provide SOC 2 scope documentation for confidentiality carveouts?

Attachments: NovaGrid_MSA_Redlines_20281201.pdf (redlines), BOL: procurement checklist

Best,
Sara
Sara Lin
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaGrid
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@novagrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-12-02T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NovaGrid redlines for MSA + order form — publicity/confidentiality items

Sara — thanks for the redlines and the clear summary. Looping in Legal (Kimberly), Marketing (Naomi) and CS (Ben) so we can get line-level answers.

Quick responses up-front:
- Logo and case study: Redwood's standard practice is to require written approval before any logo use; we typically propose a mutual opt-in rather than an opt-out. Naomi, can you confirm a reasonable approval SLA for customers?
- Embargo window: 6 months is longer than our norm for partner quotes; we usually accept 30–90 days depending on the program.
- Confidentiality: we can provide SOC 2 summary and an inventory of what we consider aggregate metrics versus customer-identifiable telemetry.

Kimberly — Sara's redlines are attached. Key legal asks are limited publicity rights and a tightened confidentiality carveout around metrics. Can you propose alternate clause language we could give them?

If acceptable to NovaGrid, I'd like to schedule a 15-minute call Wednesday to finalize wording. Proposed slots: https://cal.redwood.com/jonas/weber/15min?slot=2028-12-05T10:00

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Response_20281202.docx (response draft)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-12-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NovaGrid redlines — proposed language for publicity/confidentiality

Jonas / team — I reviewed NovaGrid's redlines and prepared recommended language and commentary. Summary points below (full text attached).

1) Publicity & logo use:
- Concern: NovaGrid's redline grants them unilateral removal rights plus a broad opt-out for any mention. We should avoid language that allows revocation of previously granted rights without a short cure period.
- Proposal (short): Mutual written consent required for any public case study or logo use. If approval is withheld, each party will state the reason and offer a remediation period of 14 days.

2) Embargo / timing:
- 90 days is a reasonable compromise; 180 days (6 months) is excessive for the types of quotes we expect. Recommend counter-offer of 90 days for customer quotes, 30 days for joint press where both parties co-author.

3) Confidentiality carveouts (metrics & benchmarks):
- We can agree to exclude aggregated, de-identified performance metrics from confidentiality so long as they cannot reasonably be re-identified. Add explicit non-identification requirement and a reference to our SOC 2 Type II report availability on request.

4) Audit & evidence:
- Provide SOC 2 summary + evidence link (we'll share a read-only audit package) and confirm retention windows in the Order Form.

I attached a short text file with redlined counter-language: Redwood_proposed_language_Publicity_Confidentiality.txt. If you want, I can draft a tracked-change MSA snippet for Sara's team.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_proposed_language_Publicity_Confidentiality.txt

From: Michael O'Rourke <michael.orourke@novagrid-legal.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@novagrid.com>, procurement@novagrid.com
Date: 2028-12-03T14:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NovaGrid redlines for MSA + order form — publicity/confidentiality items

Jonas / Kimberly — thank you for the quick reply and proposed language. A few points from NovaGrid legal: 

- Mutual consent for case studies is acceptable. However, NovaGrid requires an explicit opt-out where the customer may withhold approval for reasons of confidentiality tied to pending funding/events. We would accept a mutual process that includes a 14-day remedy window, but insist on an ability to decline without penalty.

- Embargo: NovaGrid's business often coordinates announcements with funding cycles and partner programs. We are open to 90 days for general quotes but must preserve the option for 6 months on a case-by-case basis if the customer flags sensitive timing. We propose: default 90 days, permitted extension to 180 days upon written notice before signature and documented in the Order Form.

- Metrics: We appreciate Redwood's non-identification proposal; please add a clause that prohibits combining aggregate metrics with other datasets to re-identify customers.

I've attached a short counterproposal with tracked changes (NovaGrid_legal_counterproposal_20281203.docx). If we can settle on (a) mutual consent with 14-day remedy, (b) default 90-day embargo with documented extension option, and (c) anti-reidentification guarantee around metrics, we should be able to move to signature.

Subject: Re: NovaGrid redlines for MSA + order form — publicity/confidentiality items

Thanks all — lines look close. Proposed path to signature:

1) Redwood accepts mutual written consent for publicity + logo use with a 14-day remediation window as Kimberly suggested.
2) Set default embargo to 90 days in MSA; add an Order Form field to record any agreed extensions (up to 180 days) at the customer's request.
3) Add explicit anti-reidentification language for aggregated metrics and reference to our SOC 2 summary.

Kimberly / Michael — can Legal confirm that the sentence below (draft) captures the compromise? If yes, I will ask procurement teams to update the Order Form and send a new combined redline for sign-off: 

"Mutual public announcements: Neither party shall issue any public announcement (including press releases, case studies, or logo usage) referencing the other party without prior written consent. Approval shall not be unreasonably withheld; if withheld the withholding party will provide a reason and a 14-day opportunity to cure. The default embargo for customer quotes and case studies shall be 90 days from the earliest public reference; extensions up to 180 days may be documented in the Order Form at time of signature. Aggregated, de-identified performance metrics that cannot reasonably be re-identified may be used for benchmarking and product materials, provided such use complies with the anti-reidentification obligations set forth herein and Redwood's SOC 2 policies (summary available upon request)."

If legal from both sides confirm, I will schedule a 15-minute alignment call and circulate an updated redline this afternoon. Proposed calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/jonas/weber/15min?slot=2028-12-05T10:00

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
